title: Pedestrian access leg minimum width 1.5 m
text: Where a pedestrian access leg is required to provide access from a dwelling site to a public street, it is to: i. be a minimum width of 1.5m; and ... The pedestrian access leg may be reduced to 1m where required to retain an existing dwelling.

exceptions.label: reduced to 1 m where required to retain an existing dwelling

notes: from: ch3 C3.7.12(i) (unchanged). A pedestrian access leg from a dwelling site to a public street. 'Where required to retain' is tested only as a dwelling being retained (proposal.retained_dwelling), although this chapter has no retained-dwelling element.

verified.note: 1.5m and the 1m reduction confirmed. The retention exception keeps its own verify flag: this chapter has no retained-dwelling element and 'where required to retain' is tested only as proposal.retained_dwelling.
